facts.fact: The Personal Data Protection Commission (PDPC) says on 26 March 2026 that voluntary registration ends on 8 April 2026 and enforcement of the Personal Data Protection Act, Chapter 44, begins on 9 April 2026.
The PDPC says its Director General, Dr Emmanuel Lameck Mkilia, addressed the press on 26 March 2026 and that the Commission was launched by the President in April 2024.

facts.fact: The PDPC says a registration system for controllers and processors has run since 2024, with the deadline twice extended, and that fines of up to TZS 5 billion for institutions will apply from 9 April 2026.
